data.title: Data
data.headline: Questions I wanted answered, so I ran the numbers.
data.intro: An ongoing series of original analyses — prediction market calibration, economic modelling, and geo-strategic risk. Every post publishes its methodology, its sources, its limitations, and the code, so you can disagree with the conclusion on the evidence rather than on vibes.
principles: The question comes before the dataset. If the answer isn't interesting when it goes the other way, it isn't a good question.
Methodology and sources are published with the finding, not on request.
Limitations are stated by the author, not discovered by the reader.
Every analysis is reproducible from the linked code and public data.
